Vendor learning path

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management cover procurement, inventory, warehouse management, production, planning and finance in one ERP, with Commerce for retail and Intelligent Order Management for orchestration. It integrates with the Microsoft Power Platform and Dataverse.

ERPWMSPlanningOMS

Learning path

Foundations

Beginner / BA
  • Finance vs Supply Chain Management apps
  • Legal entities, sites and warehouses
  • P2P: requisition → PO → product receipt → vendor invoice
  • O2C: sales order → picking → packing slip → invoice

Exercise. Trace one PO through to vendor payment and name each document.

Functional

Consultant
  • Procurement categories and purchase requisition workflow
  • Trade and purchase agreements
  • Invoice matching policies and tolerances
  • Warehouse management: wave templates, work templates, location directives, mobile app
  • Master planning with Planning Optimization
  • Production control basics

Exercise. Configure three-way matching with a 2% tolerance and test the 100/95/100 case.

Technical

Developer / Data
  • Data entities and OData endpoints
  • Data management framework for bulk import/export
  • Business events to Azure Service Bus / Event Grid
  • Dual-write with Dataverse
  • Extensions with X++ (no overlayering)

Exercise. Subscribe to the vendor-invoice-posted business event and push it to an analytics topic.

Architecture

Architect
  • Lifecycle Services / Power Platform admin and environment strategy
  • Integration patterns: OData vs DMF vs business events
  • Intelligent Order Management with third-party WMS
  • One version: continuous updates and regression testing

Exercise. Design D365 F&SCM + Manhattan WMS + Coupa integration.

Same concept, Dynamics 365 vocabulary

Generic termDynamics 365
SupplierVendor
Goods receiptProduct receipt
Price agreementTrade agreement / purchase agreement
Invoice matchingInvoice matching policy: not required, two-way, three-way
OrganisationLegal entity · site · warehouse
Item masterReleased product
Pick taskWork (warehouse management)
Putaway / pick rulesLocation directives
WaveWave template
MRPMaster planning / Planning Optimization
Bulk importData management framework with data entities

Use cases

Multi-entity manufacturer on one ERP

Three plants, two countries.

Shared procurement categories and vendors; intercompany orders; master planning across sites; warehouse management mobile app in each plant.

KPIs: Inventory turns · OTIF · close duration

Retailer with Commerce

Stores and e-commerce on one platform.

Dynamics 365 Commerce for POS and e-commerce; SCM for replenishment and warehouses.

KPIs: Store availability · stock accuracy

Integration surface

OData endpoints on data entities, Data management framework (DMF) packages for bulk import/export, business events to Azure Service Bus or Event Grid, dual-write with Dataverse, Power Automate connectors.

Product names and modules evolve. Verify against current Dynamics 365 documentation.
